```{r}
#| include: false
project_root <- normalizePath(if (file.exists("_targets.R")) "." else "..")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
# Keep standalone PNG/CSV exports and presentation sources tracked.
exports <- targets::tar_read(tdp43_exports)
widget_sources <- targets::tar_read(tdp43_widget_sources)
for (path in widget_sources[grepl("\\.R$", widget_sources)]) source(path)
controls_script <- widget_sources[grepl("\\.js$", widget_sources)]
```

<label for="tdp43-trend-toggle"><input type="checkbox" id="tdp43-trend-toggle"> Show trend lines and 95% confidence bands</label>

# TDP-43 by diagnostic group

```{r}
tdp43_box_view(targets::tar_read(tdp43_subtype), controls_script)
```

# TDP-43 versus age

```{r}
tdp43_scatter_view(targets::tar_read(tdp43_age), controls_script)
```
